counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 Replit Slides 应用八套专业主题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 Replit 上做演示文稿并想快速换肤。
copy.tagline_en: Apply eight professional themes to Replit Slides
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create presentations on Replit and want quick theme changes.

howto.what: 它会把你的内容做成 Replit Slides 风格的横向滑动演示文稿：先选一套主题并始终使用，页面按封面、目录、若干内容页、收尾排列，页数随内容长度增加，短内容至少 6–10 页。
howto.when: 当你要做 Replit Slides 风格的演示文稿，或提到这份技能的主题（如 helix、world-mint 等）时，它会接管排版。

say.text: 用 helix 主题做一份 10 页的产品演示 slides
say.note: 会出一套 Replit Slides 风横向滑动页。

say.text: 把这份要点做成 world-mint 主题的演示文稿
say.note: 每页按主题配色和字体排版。

say.text: 换用 bluehouse 主题重做这套 deck
say.note: 重新排版并保持整套主题统一。

howto.what_en: It turns your content into a single-file, horizontally swipeable slide deck in Replit Slides style: picks one of the eight themes and sticks to it, structures pages as cover, agenda, content, and closing, and adds more pages as content grows (short decks start at 6–10 pages).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a Replit Slides-style presentation or mention one of its themes (e.g. helix, world-mint).

say_en.text: Make a 10-page product deck with the helix theme.
say_en.note: Creates a single-file swipeable deck in that style.

say_en.text: Turn these bullet points into a world-mint presentation.
say_en.note: Layout follows the theme’s palette and fonts.

say_en.text: Rebuild this deck using the bluehouse theme.
say_en.note: Re-renders all pages with a consistent theme.
